svg.aria-label: HyperLogLog counts distinct items in a few kilobytes. Each item, such as a user ID, is hashed. The first bits of the hash pick one of many registers; the rest is checked for its run of leading zeros. Seeing a hash with many leading zeros is rare, so the longest run seen hints at how many distinct items there were: about 2 to the power of that run. Averaging over 16,384 registers gives about 0.8 percent error using 12 KB, whether there are a thousand or a billion items. Duplicates hash the same way, so they never change the count.
